name: rhesus-eradication-deals-level-plus-two-per-elysian-object
notes: Rhesus Eradication: LV + 2 per Elysian object you control. Pre-fix 0 damage ($damageAmount undefined).

rulesClauses: Deal LV+X damage to target unit, where X is two times the amount of Elysian objects you control.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Rhesus Eradication: the generated handler ($damageAmount) read a variable that was only defined in the ability body that queued it (PHP closures do not share scope), so it was undefined (null) at resolution. Overridden in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php; the value is recomputed where it is used.
